questions.prompt: Evaluate the integral from 0 to 2 of x dx.

questions.prompt: Evaluate the integral from 0 to 1 of x^2 dx.

Evaluate the integral from 0 to 1 of e^x dx.

questions.prompt: Evaluate the integral from 0 to pi of x sin x dx.
hints: Integration by parts: u=x, dv=sin x dx.

questions.prompt: Evaluate the integral from 1 to e of ln x dx.
hints: Integration by parts or known result.
